commit_message: Migrate benchmark schema for ACP runtime lanes
pr_title: GameEngine: migrate benchmark schema for ACP runtime lanes
pr_body:
## Summary

- add benchmark schema v4 with Raw Model, Agent Harness, and Coding Agent runtime identities
- preserve schema v1-v3 records as legacy-harness evidence without reinterpretation
- add ACP-aware runtime, harness, adapter, tool-contract, permission, and telemetry boundaries
- extend campaign schema v3 with frozen agent-inclusive runtime identity and model-only comparison guards
- keep ACP-unobservable model turns and token counts explicitly unavailable

## Validation

This is a parallel authoring subtask. Heavy cargo, Windows, and Visual Validation are intentionally deferred to final integration. Canonical request build/preflight remains required.
